title: Structured Cabling: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Cables are a building's utility grid. A few strict rules keep it working. You need to know the numbers.

scenes.heading: Numbers to remember
scenes.narration: Here are the key limits. The permanent link is ninety metres. The full channel, with patch cords, is a hundred. Cat six only does ten gig for fifty five metres. Pick T five six eight A or B, and don't mix them.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. Patch cords count toward the hundred. Pick one standard for the building. Cat six A is needed for the full distance.

items.wrong: Only the run counts toward 100 m
Cat6 is fine for 10G at full length

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva structured cabling lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Ninety metres of cable, and a hundred in total. Cat six A for full distance ten gig. One wiring standard per site. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva structured cabling lab.
